svg.title: From a common centre flow to an isomorphism of factors
svg.desc: Two continuous cores are measurably identified with L infinity of X tensor the hyperfinite semifinite factor Q. Their traces are normalized to the same reference trace. Equality of fibre multipliers gives a trace-preserving field conjugacy Phi and a continuous unitary cocycle U. The crossed-product map sends a to Phi of a and lambda one of t to U t adjoint times lambda two of t. Normal recovery identifies the original factors.

g.text: The centre flow determines the factor
Separable AFD factors of type III₀ · proof: FWC-01–09
First core action θ¹ on 𝒩
Second core action θ² on 𝒩
τref θ²ₜ = e⁻ᵗ τref = τref θ¹ₜ
Fibre multipliers: Dₜ(x) mᵢ(t,x) = e⁻ᵗ, so m₁ = m₂
The fibre difference is in Autτ₀(Q) = closure of Inn(Q). [FWC-04]
Uₛ₊ₜ = Uₛ γₛ(Uₜ), γ = Φθ¹Φ⁻¹ · continuous unitary cocycle [FWC-05–07]
a ↦ Φ(a), λ₁(t) ↦ Uₜ* λ₂(t) · normal onto map · M₁ ≅ M₂ [FWC-08]
The trace gauge is b₋log h. The inverse on the unitary coefficient is essential.
